title: The requirement backlog refuses unknown and recipe keys
statement: The writer MUST refuse any unknown key in a requirement backlog, naming recipe and executor keys by name with their proper home.
why: A strict schema is the mechanical guard against recipes and executor detail entering the backlog.

acceptance.text: Given an increment carrying a list of files to touch, when it is ingested, then it is refused with a message that the plan owns files.
Given an increment carrying an executor field, when it is ingested, then it is refused and the message names the run configuration as that field's home.

falsifiedBy: A saved requirement backlog that contains a recipe or executor key.

sources.quote: that refuses recipe and executor keys by name
